name: Autocomplete
description:
Root of the compound component. Holds the data and the shared options and makes itself available to its parts (AutocompleteInput, AutocompleteList, …).

  Autocomplete(items: frameworks) do
    AutocompleteInput(placeholder: "Search a framework")
    AutocompleteContent do
      AutocompleteEmpty { "No frameworks found." }
      AutocompleteList do |item|
        AutocompleteItem(value: item) { item }
      end
    end
  end
usage: Call the kit method inside a Phlex view that includes UI (e.g. `Autocomplete(**props) { … }`); unknown keywords (class:, id:, data:, aria_*) go to the root element.

AutocompleteCollection.description: Maps over the items of the enclosing AutocompleteGroup

AutocompleteContent.description: The popup wrapping AutocompleteEmpty + AutocompleteList. Hidden until the Stimulus controller opens it; flips above the input when there is no room below.

AutocompleteEmpty.description: Shown only when the filter matches nothing

AutocompleteGroup.description:
A labelled group of options for grouped items ({ value:, items: }).

  AutocompleteList do |group|
    AutocompleteGroup(items: group[:items]) do
      AutocompleteLabel { group[:value] }
      AutocompleteCollection { |item| AutocompleteItem(value: item) { item } }
    end
  end

AutocompleteInput.description:
The text field, styled like Appica's Input. Renders the clear button and the chevron toggle when the root has `clearable:` / `icon:`.

start_slot: / end_slot: accept a String, a Proc (rendered in this component), or :selected_icon to mirror the selected item's `data-icon="start"` element.

AutocompleteItem.description: One option. `value:` is what selection writes into the input; for object items it is read through the root's item_to_string_value.

examples.name: Usage
examples.code:
phlex do
  Autocomplete(size:, variant:, clearable:, icon:, grid:, disabled:, **given(value:, default_value:, name:), items: FRAMEWORKS) do
    AutocompleteInput(placeholder:, aria_label: placeholder)
    AutocompleteContent do
      AutocompleteEmpty { "No frameworks found." }
      AutocompleteList do |item|
        AutocompleteItem(value: item) { item }
      end
    end
  end
end

examples.name: Variants
examples.notes: `variant:` switches the input between a bordered outline (default) and a filled soft field.
examples.code:
phlex do
  [ :outline, :soft ].each do |variant|
    Autocomplete(items: FRAMEWORKS, variant:) do
      AutocompleteInput(placeholder: "Search a framework", aria_label: "Search (#{variant})")
      AutocompleteContent do
        AutocompleteEmpty { "No frameworks found." }
        AutocompleteList { |item| AutocompleteItem(value: item) { item } }
      end
    end
  end
end

examples.name: Sizes
examples.notes: `size:` on the root scales the input, popup radius, and items together.
examples.code:
phlex do
  [ :sm, :md, :lg ].each do |size|
    Autocomplete(items: FRAMEWORKS, size:) do
      AutocompleteInput(placeholder: "Search a framework", aria_label: "Search (#{size})")
      AutocompleteContent do
        AutocompleteEmpty { "No frameworks found." }
        AutocompleteList { |item| AutocompleteItem(value: item) { item } }
      end
    end
  end
end

examples.name: Clearable & chevron
examples.notes: `clearable:` adds a clear (✕) button once there's a value, `icon:` a chevron that toggles the popup.
examples.code:
phlex do
  Autocomplete(items: FRAMEWORKS, default_value: "Next.js", clearable: true, icon: true) do
    AutocompleteInput(placeholder: "Search a framework", aria_label: "Search a framework")
    AutocompleteContent do
      AutocompleteEmpty { "No frameworks found." }
      AutocompleteList { |item| AutocompleteItem(value: item) { item } }
    end
  end
end

examples.name: Items with icons
examples.notes:
Object items need `item_to_string_value:`. Mark a leading icon with `data-icon="start"`;
`start_slot: :selected_icon` mirrors the selected item's icon into the input.
examples.code:
phlex do
  Autocomplete(items: COMMANDS, item_to_string_value: :label, clearable: true, icon: true) do
    AutocompleteInput(placeholder: "Search commands", aria_label: "Search commands", start_slot: :selected_icon)
    AutocompleteContent do
      AutocompleteEmpty { "No commands found." }
      AutocompleteList do |command|
        AutocompleteItem(value: command) do
          Icon(command[:icon], data: { icon: "start" })
          plain command[:label]
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

examples.name: Country search
examples.code:
phlex do
  Autocomplete(items: COUNTRIES, item_to_string_value: :name, clearable: true, icon: true) do
    AutocompleteInput(placeholder: "Search a country", aria_label: "Search a country", start_slot: :selected_icon)
    AutocompleteContent do
      AutocompleteEmpty { "No countries found." }
      AutocompleteList do |country|
        AutocompleteItem(value: country) do
          flag = country[:code].chars.map { |char| (char.ord + 127_397).chr(Encoding::UTF_8) }.join
          span(class: "text-base leading-none", aria_hidden: "true", data: { icon: "start" }) { flag }
          plain country[:name]
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

examples.name: Grouped options
examples.notes: Grouped items (`{ value:, items: }`) render with AutocompleteGroup + AutocompleteLabel + AutocompleteCollection.
examples.code:
phlex do
  Autocomplete(items: PRODUCE) do
    AutocompleteInput(placeholder: "Search produce", aria_label: "Search produce")
    AutocompleteContent do
      AutocompleteEmpty { "No produce found." }
      AutocompleteList do |group|
        AutocompleteGroup(items: group[:items]) do
          AutocompleteLabel { group[:value] }
          AutocompleteCollection do |item|
            AutocompleteItem(value: item) { item }
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

examples.name: Grid layout
examples.notes: `grid: true` lays options out in a grid (arrow keys move in two dimensions); `cols:` sets items per row.
examples.code:
phlex do
  Autocomplete(items: LIBRARIES, grid: true, icon: true) do
    AutocompleteInput(placeholder: "Search a library", aria_label: "Search a library")
    AutocompleteContent do
      AutocompleteEmpty { "No libraries found." }
      AutocompleteList(cols: 2) do |item|
        AutocompleteItem(value: item, class: "flex-1") { item }
      end
    end
  end
end

examples.name: Static items & form
examples.notes: Static AutocompleteItem children work too. `name:` submits the typed/selected value with the form.
examples.code:
phlex do
  form(action: "#", class: "flex flex-col gap-3") do
    Autocomplete(name: "framework") do
      AutocompleteInput(placeholder: "Pick a framework", aria_label: "Pick a framework")
      AutocompleteContent do
        AutocompleteEmpty { "No frameworks found." }
        AutocompleteList do
          AutocompleteItem(value: "Rails") { "Rails" }
          AutocompleteItem(value: "Hanami") { "Hanami" }
          AutocompleteItem(value: "Sinatra", disabled: true) { "Sinatra (disabled)" }
        end
      end
    end
  end
end
